title: Decay estimates for the two-dimensional Beam equation with potentials
summary: This paper establishes time decay estimates for the following two-dimensional beam (plate) equation with a decaying real-valued potential $V$: \begin{equation*} \partial_t^2 u + (Δ^2 + V) u = 0, \qquad u(0,x)=f(x),\quad \partial_t u(0,x)=g(x). \end{equation*} When zero is a regular point or a first-kind resonance of $H=Δ^2+V$, we first prove sharp $L^1\to L^\infty$ estimates for the solution operators: \begin{align*} \left\|\cos(t\sqrt{H})P_{\mathrm{ac}}(H)\right\|_{L^1\to L^\infty} + \left\|\frac{\sin(t\sqrt{H})}{t\sqrt{H}}P_{\mathrm{ac}}(H)\right\|_{L^1\to L^\infty} \lesssim \frac{1}{|t|},…
